title: A Field Scenario File: One Text File for the Ground, the Walls, the Goals and the Faults, Parsed With Every Mistake Reported at Once

questions.question: Why is a test better as a file than as a function?
options: It can be kept, shared, repeated and given to another simulator
questions.explanation: A test must outlive the run.

questions.question: A file with six mistakes gave how many reports?
options: 8, with their lines, six for lines and two for the whole file

questions.question: Where is the check that a file has a start made?
options: After the last line, because it concerns the whole file
questions.explanation: Some rules are about the whole.

questions.question: What is the result of parsing, writing, parsing and writing?
questions.explanation: Nothing is lost on the round trip.

questions.question: Why report a line number and the word that was wrong?
options: So the mistake can be found and fixed in one pass
questions.explanation: A message must point at the thing.

questions.question: Why are angles in a scenario in degrees but in code in radians?
options: A person writes 90, and the conversion is made once at the edge
